scopeNotes: All paths are expanded under .validation-output/reverse-requirements/<evaluation-id>/first and /repaired and are declared before the first generation.
Each workspace holds only inputs/requirements.md, inputs/contracts.json and the six sources above. Hidden acceptance/evidence stay outside the workspace.
Each round also declares source-manifest.json, dist/index.html, dist/app.js, build-report.json, build.log, serve.log, result.json and report.md.
A source manifest is written only after actual source files exist; no future source hash is invented in advance.
Build assets are restricted to the one JavaScript bundle and local index.html; CSS/fonts/images are inlined. Unexpected assets fail without expanding the approved scope.
serve.log is an append-only run log, not an immutable verdict. Actual browser/access evidence and the supplied results are separately recorded; not-run items must not acquire invented evidence files.
The prepared plan is still a candidate: this attachment does not confirm D01-D07, a user display name or generation authorization.
The first snapshot/result is retained before repairing. Changed requirements, tool bytes or plan scope require a new evaluation, not a repaired score.
